name: AICardTrustSummary
description: The Trust Summary Card is the primary governance surface for AI-generated outputs. It visualises a confidence arc (0–100%), risk level, data quality stars, data freshness, source count, and whether human review is required — all in a compact card pattern for embedding alongside AI outputs in dashboards and reports.
intent: Governance surface for AI-generated outputs. Visualises confidence level, risk, data quality, and freshness — and flags when human review is required.

authority.note: Imported from godesign27/agentic-ui-design-system (branch cursor/import-ai-components-6d77). Runtime TSX lives under src/components/ai/. Existing top-level shadcn ports remain authoritative for the governed AI kit.

props.name: confidence
props.hint: Confidence score 0–100. Tone (green/amber/red) is derived from this value.

props.name: lastUpdated
props.hint: Human-readable last updated value (e.g. "2 hours ago", "Jun 6, 2026").

props.name: sources
props.hint: Source chip labels rendered as bordered pills. Falls back to "N sources" if absent.

props.name: sourceCount
props.hint: Number of data sources — used when `sources` is not provided.

props.name: requiresReview
props.hint: Toggles the Request Review footer button.

props.name: onRequestReview
props.hint: Called when the Request Review button is clicked.

props.name: onViewSources
props.hint: Called when "View sources" link is clicked.
